name: Float Hypervisors mint and redeem shares at the pool's instantaneous tick
summary: Float Protocol's Visor-style Hypervisors on the FLOAT/WETH Uniswap V3 pool price deposits and holdings at the pool's current tick. Their only guard, the DepositProxy ratio check, compares against the same manipulable holdings. Swapping the pool, depositing through the DepositProxy, swapping back and withdrawing returns more than was deposited.
notes: Hypervisor B ages from the owner's appendList adding DepositProxy 0x7cf8431e. With the whitelist switched on two blocks later, that proxy is the only way in. Later changes only tightened it (depositDelta 20 to 11).

Loss is the per-transaction drop in each Hypervisor's getTotalAmounts(), since its liquidity sits in the pool where transfer logs cannot see it: B lost WETH in the anchor, and A (0x85cbed52, through proxy 0x38037294) and B lost FLOAT and WETH in the copycat. The anchor's FLOAT gain in B is not subtracted. FLOAT is valued at DefiLlama's price; the attackers realised about $36.8k.
The anchor and 0x3d7549db are the only transactions in either Hypervisor's history that deposit and withdraw in the same transaction.
